narrative.overview:
The system feels like a campus that welcomes everyone: airy surfaces, real photographs and clear paths. Its voice is clear, trustworthy and friendly, so applicants and parents can understand a page before they have to study it.

English and Thai share one interface without a language switcher. Sky tones carry wayfinding, navy gives authority, and yellow marks the step toward applying.
keyCharacteristics: Light surfaces with authentic campus imagery.
English headings; Thai small text beneath them.
Flat surfaces that lift when a visitor interacts.

rules.name: The White-on-Sky Rule
rules.body: Never add white text on Campus Cyan or Campus Sky. White on Campus Cyan measures 2.53:1; use Campus Link instead. Existing footer, contact, active-news-filter and primary detail-page button uses are debt to fix, not precedent.

rules.name: The Yellow Invitation Rule
rules.body: Reserve Apply Yellow for action and pair it with dark ink.

rules.name: The English-Lead Rule
rules.body: Headings and main labels are English. Small text is Thai: the subtitle under a heading, descriptions, notes and tags. Do not repeat a description in both languages. The Thai-led homepage hero is marked as a client lock and needs an owner decision before changing.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: New surfaces are flat by default and lift only in response to interaction.

dos: Do use real campus, student and faculty imagery.
Do use Campus Link (#00738F) behind white text.
Do write headings in English and small text in Thai.
Do reserve Apply Yellow (#FAC315) for action.
donts: Don't put new white text on Campus Cyan (#00B3C9) or Campus Sky (#00A8D0).
Don't introduce another icon library; the site uses Font Awesome.
Don't hardcode a new color when an existing token covers the role.
Don't treat legacy shadows or Thai-led labels as precedent for new work.
